features.summary: A garage for **multiple vehicles on one account**, with Ford's vehicle list and a manual fallback. Each widget can stay attached to a particular vehicle independently of the vehicle currently open in the app.

Vehicle readings where reported: fuel/range, EV charge/range, plug and charging status, 12V battery, tires, oil, locks, doors/hood, odometer, outside temperature and parked location. Missing readings remain unknown; healthy incomplete door/lock reports are labeled partial.
Classic, Showcase and Dashboard designs, Home Screen sizes and Lock Screen views, vehicle photos, and US/Metric formats with independent PSI/kPa/bar tire pressure.
Four- and six-wheel tire layouts. Owners choose front/rear low-pressure thresholds; **tire alerts start off until configured**.

Vehicle-specific feature and control choices. Lock/unlock and engine start/stop retain confirmations and cooldowns; commands start disabled and must be enabled for that vehicle. Start/Stop also require owner verification of engine control. EV climate/conditioning and charging controls are not implemented.

Optional **Pro Power Onboard** status per vehicle. A/B, total and capacity estimates are limited to the corroborated 7.2 kW HEV mapping; other variants show mapping-unverified/raw details. Pro Power is off by default.
A confirmed Refresh action, cached-reading ages, configurable alerts and redacted troubleshooting reports.
